sunfields.name: The Sunfields
sunfields.text: A wide, harshly sunlit frontier of hard pale earth, glassed patches, exposed dark metal ribs, sparse roads and settlements separated by long open distances. Sunforge remnants may appear beside roads, under homes or at settlement edges as weathered structural objects incorporated into ordinary life.

last-drop.name: The Last Drop Saloon
last-drop.text: Dusty frontier saloon and settlement center with splintered boards, a patched bar, a dark rear wall, hard white daylight at the doors, hitching rails and a rough back lot/loading yard of timber beams, barrels, crates and bare dirt.

cinder-basin.name: Cinder Basin / Los Lagartos Camp
cinder-basin.text: White alkali dust, fractured basalt, patched canvas shade, cookfires, tethered mounts and a traveling camp arranged around the exposed dark ribs of a half-buried Sunforge.

mirage-club.name: The Mirage Club
mirage-club.text: Subterranean frontier cabaret of oxidized copper, dark wood, old mirrors, small performance spaces, narrow stairs and private back rooms. A visible hand-painted NO NAMES BELOW notice marks the stair into the club.

relay-station.name: Relay Settlement
relay-station.text: Worn frontier settlement gathered beneath an old relay tower, with message boards, communal tables, patched sleeping corners, side rooms, weathered equipment housings and travelers' gear.

bellweather.name: Bellweather
bellweather.text: Close family settlement arranged around shaded courtyards, long meal tables, shared houses, covered walkways and practical work spaces used across generations.

rowan-hold.name: Rowan Hold
rowan-hold.text: Settled agricultural community of shade trees, low stone houses, work yards and a shared record room. An exposed black Sunforge arc crosses the common yard and is used as ordinary seating.

long-mile.name: The Long Mile
long-mile.text: Open pale road through white ground, low ridges and dry washes with long sight lines, sparse scrub and very few structures. Heat shimmer and repeated ridge lines make distance genuinely difficult to judge.

saint-oren.name: Saint Oren's
saint-oren.text: Settled community built directly around a massive exposed black ribbed structure. Homes, tables, shade cloth and everyday gathering spaces press close to it, and locals use the structure itself for ordinary shade and seating.

rookery.name: The Rookery
rookery.text: Dense crossroads settlement of boarding rooms, family workshops, courtyards, market tables, roof walks and narrow passages. Several dark structural remnants are embedded in different parts of the settlement and used differently by locals.

glasshouse.name: Glasshouse
glasshouse.text: Lived-in settlement of shaded courtyards, old translucent panels, low homes, shared tables and patched work spaces softened by years of ordinary use.

hushwater.name: Hushwater
hushwater.text: Modest settlement of shaded houses, a communal dining court, household gardens and record shelves. No obvious Sunforge dominates the center.
